listing.fhsz: Very High FHSZ (presumptive) — 94611 Montclair hills, Snake Rd corridor inside/near the 1991 Oakland firestorm footprint; verify on CAL FIRE map; always raise insurance-availability flag for Oakland hills zips
listing.style: Contemporary / mid-century post-and-beam (1967), two-story on downhill lot plus street-level garage; dark-stained shingle + T1-11 wood siding
listing.description: Stunning mid-century hideaway perched in one of the Bay Area's most coveted urban forests, offering a rare blend of architectural artistry & natural serenity. A wall of glass frames sweeping, unobstructed 180-degree views of Oakland, Emeryville, San Francisco, Marin, Alcatraz & both the Golden Gate & Bay Bridges. Original, organic architecture shines throughout w/ an open floorplan, dramatic exposed beams & a striking cedar accent wall that greets you upon entry, filling the space w/ the warm scent of natural wood. Recently updated kitchen features leathered stone counters & stainless appliances, surrounded by the home's natural materials & character. Thoughtfully designed two-level living offers wonderful separation of space, w/ wrap-around decks on both levels inviting you to soak in bay views from sunrise to sunset. Majestic trees frame the property on all sides for a true sense of retreat, just minutes from everyday convenience. Large two-car garage adds practicality, while the location delivers the best of both worlds: moments from hiking & biking trails & the shops & restaurants of Montclair Village. Quick access to Hwy 13 places San Francisco, Lamorinda & the 580 corridor all within easy reach. More than a home, this is a retreat you'll never want to leave.

natural_light.note: Full west glass wall + sliders, skylights (p_04, p_07), bright open plan (p_02, p_16); lower bedrooms still get sliders and real light (p_33, p_35, p_37); no dark rooms seen.

character.note: Authentic 1967 MCM: post-and-beam vaulted ceilings, cedar accent wall (p_03, p_06), slab wood doors (p_40), black steel rails, glass walls (p_02, p_16); reads architect-designed, not tract.

kitchen.note: Recent tasteful reno: leathered dark counters, green tile, NXR 5-burner gas range + hood (p_13, p_14), garden window over farmhouse sink (p_12), island/bar (p_09, p_10); compact 10x8.5 footprint and value-tier appliances hold it below 5.

privacy.note: View side is a private tree canyon, but side neighbors sit ~30-40 ft away with direct sightlines onto decks (p_28, p_29) and the house hangs below the street (p_26, p_52); kitchen/deck activity visible to uphill neighbors.

layout_flow.note: Open living-dining-kitchen around a central stair (p_07, p_15), decks wrap three sides (p_53 floor plan), 2+2 beds over two levels; daily life means stairs (entry at main level, garage at street above, primary suite below).

primary_suite.note: True en-suite reads as the lower-level bedroom w/ slider + view (p_37, p_40, p_41 bath via slab door, p_46 laundry adjacent) per floor plan's basement ENS (p_53); main-level bedrooms are smaller and share the hall bath (p_22).

outdoor_space.note: Two stacked wraparound decks (~80+ linear ft total, p_01, p_20, p_26, p_43, p_44), dining + lounge zones, redwoods piercing the deck (p_01, p_28); no usable ground-level yard (steep lot).

condition.note: Interiors renovated to a high standard (kitchen, both baths p_22/p_41, floors, laundry w/ new LG pair p_46); exterior cladding is older T1-11 + stained shakes (p_30, p_52), deck joists/skylights/flat garage-roof sections uninspected; systems age unknown.

lot_usability.note: 0.22 ac but a steep triangular downhill parcel (p_47 drone, p_53 site plan): usable outdoor = decks only; brushy slope below decks (p_43); no flat lawn, no ADU pad.

verdict: A genuine architectural view house: 1967 post-and-beam MCM with real two-level bay-to-Golden-Gate views, wraparound decks, and a recently renovated interior — trading a usable yard, side privacy, and fire-hardened construction for treetop living on a steep, below-street lot in the Very High fire zone. The market agreed violently: it closed at $1.675M, 86% over the $899K bait price. As a comp it sets the ceiling for the buyer's view-quality benchmark near Snake Rd; as a target, anything similar hitting the market will require a same-week decision and an insurance quote before offer.

crosschecks.result: Mostly verified: glass wall + beams + cedar (p_02, p_03), updated kitchen (p_09-p_15), wrap decks both levels (p_20, p_43), 'both bridges' verified by telephoto (p_50, p_51). Overstated: 'unobstructed 180°' — views are real but tree-framed at eye level; 'Waterfront' amenity tag is false (hillside, ~3 mi from shore); drone shot p_48 flatters beyond deck reality but is corroborated by deck shots p_31/p_44. Honest listing overall with normal agent adjectives.

FLAG: Census (37.8350493, -122.2022966) vs Compass parcel (37.8356171, -122.201897) are ~237 ft apart; elevations 1,100 ft vs 1,118 ft. 237 ft > 150 ft threshold. Parcel pin kept as canonical; likely geocoder snapped to street segment centroid.

1,118 ft on Snake Rd, Montclair Hills — ~120 ft above the 6401-snake reference comp (998 ft) and 2.5x its size (2,023 sf vs 1,379 sf); closed $1.675M = $828/sf vs that listing's $998K ask ($724/sf). Neighbors on street sold for $2.1M (4bd/3ba, 2,110 sf, verified) and $1.35M (3bd/2ba, 2,002 sf) per Compass nearby-sales data — ~$790-995/sf band; this close is in-band, not an outlier.

View side W-WNW: sunset-over-bay deck shot (p_01), bridge telephotos (p_49-p_51), floor-plan north arrow places balcony west, driveway/garage east (p_53). Afternoon sun, tree-filtered. Labeled inference — photo+plan corroboration, not compass-verified.

94611 Montclair = Very High FHSZ (presumptive); Snake Rd corridor inside/near the 1991 firestorm footprint; wood decks + shake siding + steep brushy lot compound exposure. Insurance-availability flag raised; FAIR Plan risk real. Verify designation on the CAL FIRE FHSZ map before any comparable offer.

Montclair Village ~1.5 mi downhill — plausible 'minutes' claim (area amenity, not property feature); Hwy 13 access immediate (Snake Rd parallels it). 'Hiking & biking trails' = Sibley/Huckleberry preserves ~2 mi up-ridge — plausibly minutes by car. Vineyard across canyon visible in drone shot (p_47) is a nice surprise, uncredited in copy.

Legitimate 4bd: floor plan (p_53) shows 2 beds main level + 2 beds lower level, all windowed w/ closets; photos corroborate 4 distinct staged bedrooms (p_18/23, p_33-35, p_37-40). 2 full baths only (main hall + lower ENS) — 4bd/2ba is bath-scarce at $1.7M; only bedroom adjacency quirk is the ENS sitting off the lower-level suite.
